root_cause.text: During mesh teardown, batadv_gw_node_free() removes all gateway nodes from the list but fails to clear and release the reference to the currently selected gateway (bat_priv->gw.curr_gw), leaving a dangling pointer that can cause use-after-free or other issues when the mesh is recreated.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of lines that atomically replace bat_priv->gw.curr_gw with NULL using rcu_replace_pointer and then drop the reference via batadv_gw_node_put inside batadv_gw_node_free(). The commit message explicitly states that the current gateway is not cleared, leaving stale gateway state across cleanup that can break later mesh recreation.
